title: Qaid hai aziyat hai aur yateem bacchi hai
body:
QAID HAI AZIYAT HAI AUR YATEEM BACHI HAI
Kehti hai mere baba do pata mujhe apna
Neend kaise aayegi seena jab nahi tera
Marna jaon aye baba ro ke bain karti hai
<<MINI>>
Yaad karke baba ko raat din jo roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghut raha hai dam mera god mein utha lejeye
Kuch kaho phuphi amma main jeyun yahan kaise
Chaye hai har taraf is ja kaise ye udasi
<<MINI>>
Yaad karke baba ko raat din jo roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye chacha chale aao ab na pani mangungi
Aake naher se ammu kuch khabar to lo meri
Hai phata huwa kurta kaan mere zaqmi
<<MINI>>
Yaad karke baba ko raat din jo roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Gaal donon zaqmi hai lahu mein bhara kurta
Hai yaqeen mujhe amma hoga ye kafan mera
Jane kis taraf basti baba ne basaye hai
<<MINI>>
Yaad karke baba ko raat din jo roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Honge kab reha bhaiya is andhere zindaa’n se
Maut mujh ko ajaye maango sab dua mil ke
Mujh ko meri qismat ye kaise din dikhaye hai
<<MINI>>
Yaad karke baba ko raat din jo roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jake darya pe zindaa’n ke bain karti thi ro kar Kyun taras nahi khata koi meri halat par
Abhi jaon maqtal se baba jaa’n dohaye hai
<<MINI>>
Yaad karke baba ko raat din jo roti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek din Sohail aaya Sar-e-Hussain ka milne
Beti haal kehti thi sar laga ke seene se
Bekasi mein ghurbat mein maut usko aaye hai
<<MINI>>
Yaad karke baba ko raat din jo roti hai
